verdict.rationale: Typesense describes itself as a "typo-tolerant search engine" out of the box (docs-25, docs-40). Its ranking guide has a dedicated "Tuning Typo Tolerance" section (docs-10), and a community user praised the fuzzy text matching (comm-15). However, the evidence names the tuning section without showing which rules or parameters it exposes. missing for 10: specifics of the tunable typo rules (e.g., number of typos allowed, minimum word length, per-field controls) and in-depth hands-on corroboration of typo-handling quality.
